_comment: Acceptance baseline for scripts/acceptance.sh. Papers in `known_pass` currently emit Typst that compiles (BYETEX-attributable PASS); the gate FAILS if any of them regresses to BYETEX_FAIL. `known_fail` are the currently-open BYETEX_FAIL papers (allowed; a fix flips one and should be promoted to known_pass). Only papers whose payloads are present locally are checked, so the gate is robust to gitignored corpus payloads. Update deliberately when fixing/breaking a paper. Captured 2026-07-25 via `corpus_sweep.sh --with-oracle` (PASS 68 / BYETEX_FAIL 0) after the ground-up review-fix batch; the entry-file disambiguation fix made 5 previously-unconvertible repos (ambiguous \documentclass) reachable, and they compile.

_known_fail_notes.ctan-memoir: typst: unclosed delimiter + unclosed label. A literal `*` in the memoir manual's prose is emitted unescaped and opens strong emphasis. Long-standing: reproduces at 701dfbe. Was hidden as INPUT_BROKEN.
_known_fail_notes.gh-maurovm-thesis-template: typst: label `<prior1977physical>` does not exist. The oxengthesis class's `\listofreferences` is unsupported, so no `#bibliography` renders while `\cite` still emits `@key`. Partially fixed in the cite-validation PR; the remaining case is citations inside `\input`ed files. Was hidden as INPUT_BROKEN.
